items.title: Dolly Douroux Adams Interview, 1962-04-18
items.q: my first numbers on the piano were Casey Jones and Steamboat Bill.

ctx.x: Can you tell us when you first started in music and the very first music you remember hearing?
Well, I first started playing at 7 years old. And my first numbers on the piano were Casey Jones and Steamboat Bill.
I know the Casey Jones. I don't know the Steamboat Bill. I don't think so.
